parameters.text:
=You map a new joiner to the correct row of the eFuture Media onboarding Role Template, then supply the content for a "Role reference" panel.

JOINER ROLE: {{ $('Joiner fields').first().json.role }}
JOINER DEPARTMENT: {{ $('Joiner fields').first().json.department }}

ROLE TEMPLATE PAGE (Confluence storage format):
{{ ($json.body && $json.body.storage) ? $json.body.storage.value : '' }}

Find the single row of the "Role matrix — tools & who to meet" table that best matches the joiner's role and department.

Return ONLY a raw JSON object. No markdown code fences, no commentary before or after it. Exactly these keys:
{"matched": true, "role_family": "", "tool_bundle": "", "who_to_meet": "", "plan_owner": ""}

Rules:
- Set "matched" to false when no row is a clear match; then set the other four values to empty strings.
- Never invent a tool bundle, a meeting list or an owner that is not present in the table.
- tool_bundle: the matched row's "Tool bundle (on top of baseline)" cell as one line, items separated by " · ".
- who_to_meet: the matched row's "Who to meet (role-specific)" cell, same formatting.
- plan_owner: the matched row's "Bundle owner / 2-week plan owner" cell as plain text; convert any @mention to a plain name.
- Every value must be plain text: no HTML, no XML tags, no newlines and no double quote characters.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ subject: 'Start — ' + $('Joiner fields').first().json.full_name + ($('Joiner fields').first().json.role ? ' (' + $('Joiner fields').first().json.role + ')' : ''), start: { dateTime: $('Joiner fields').first().json.hired_on + 'T08:00:00', timeZone: ($('Get mailbox timezone').first().json.timeZone || 'Europe/Zagreb') }, end: { dateTime: $('Joiner fields').first().json.hired_on + 'T09:00:00', timeZone: ($('Get mailbox timezone').first().json.timeZone || 'Europe/Zagreb') }, body: { contentType: 'HTML', content: 'New joiner onboarding card: ' + ($('Page link (created)').first().json.page_url || 'page not created — check the workflow execution') } }) }}

assignments.name: termination_date
assignments.value: ={{ (function(){ var a = String($('Webhook').first().json.body.data.attributes.termination_effective_date || '').trim(); var b = String($('Webhook').first().json.body.data.attributes.termination_last_day_office_on || '').trim(); var v = [a, b].filter(function(x){ return x; }).sort(); return v.length ? v[0] : ''; })() }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ subject: 'Termination — ' + $('Termination fields').first().json.full_name + ($('Termination fields').first().json.role ? ' (' + $('Termination fields').first().json.role + ')' : ''), start: { dateTime: $('Termination fields').first().json.termination_date + 'T15:00:00', timeZone: ($('Get mailbox timezone (termination)').first().json.timeZone || 'Europe/Zagreb') }, end: { dateTime: $('Termination fields').first().json.termination_date + 'T16:00:00', timeZone: ($('Get mailbox timezone (termination)').first().json.timeZone || 'Europe/Zagreb') }, body: { contentType: 'HTML', content: 'Offboarding — ' + $('Termination fields').first().json.full_name } }) }}
